schema.description: Blind two-judge grading of both systems' answers to questions.json, one answer per judge call. Each item id maps to {system: [verdict per judge]}. Judges saw the question, the kind, the listening position, the gold, the unheard_facts (ahead/mixed) and ONE answer with no system label; they never saw the other system's answer. Two judges per item and system, so n = 2 x questions in the aggregate.
schema.verdict.correct: one of correct | partial | wrong | refused_appropriately | refused_wrongly, per kind as the judge prompt defines (ahead items: refused_appropriately is the target label; mixed items never use refused_appropriately)
schema.verdict.spoiler: true if the answer states a fact from unheard_facts (text at or after the listening position); evidence quotes the leaked text
schema.order: (question, system, judge) tasks shuffled with seed 20261008
